name: Phoenicia University
englishBachelors: English-medium teaching is not stated on the pages checked; English placement tests and ENGL courses are used.
summary: Private university founded in 2015 in the Zahrani district of South Lebanon, with colleges of business, engineering, arts and sciences, architecture, law and public health.

ib.text: No IB rule is published. PU asks for the Lebanese Baccalaureate or an equivalent recognised by MEHE, Grade 10-12 transcripts and major placement tests; IB is not named.

languageOfInstruction.note: No page checked states that degrees are taught in English. PU runs English placement tests, an Intensive English Program and ENGL 101/201 courses.

notes: Gap: no IB-specific rule, points, subject or grade guidance, or Course Results policy is published. Applicants send the Lebanese Baccalaureate "or its recognized equivalent" certified by MEHE, so ask PU how it treats the IB Diploma.

Gap: no fall 2027 application or entrance-assessment dates are published. The registrar calendar shows the fall 2026-27 admissions deadline (25 September 2026) and 2026 entrance assessments from 29 June to 10 July 2026.

Documents: online form, photo, ID or passport, sealed school transcripts for grades 10-12, the Baccalaureate or equivalent, English test results or the PU English placement test, and SAT scores via College Board code 10332 where asked. Application fee LBP 800,000, covering placement tests.

Selection: the admissions committee reviews transcripts, the major placement test for each major applied to, the English placement result and Baccalaureate exam results. Freshman entry needs MEHE freshman permission and SAT 950 (science) or 870 (arts), or ACT 17 / 15.

English proof: PU English placement test (50 to 150 scale) or Duolingo, TOEFL iBT, SAT reading and writing or IELTS Academic; the score sets the English level. Undergraduates with IELTS 7 or TOEFL iBT 111 start at ENGL 201.

Fees: 2026-27 per-credit tuition is USD 195 for most degrees (Computer Science, Communication, Business, public health, nursing), USD 220 for engineering, USD 210 architecture and USD 180 law. 45% is paid in USD and the rest in LBP at LL 38,000 per dollar. Up to 17 credits per semester. 2027-28 fees are not published.
No programme durations in years are stated on the pages checked (business: 91 credits from sophomore, 121 from freshman), so no flagship programme is listed.
Recognition: the pages checked show IACBE and FIBAA programme accreditation and a UniRanks listing, but not the Lebanese education ministry (MEHE) licence, which stays unconfirmed.
